definition: to press something firmly into place
description: A wet peat bog on a grey day. A young woman in a red rain jacket, a knit hat and green wellies kneels in the black mud and presses a clump of green moss firmly into the waterlogged ground, then lifts her hands, wipes her arm and reaches for the next spot. Long rows of moss clumps already planted stretch away beside her. Behind her other volunteers in rain jackets plant more or carry sacks, rolls of brown matting are stacked by a wooden boardwalk, a small hut stands on the horizon and a bird flies overhead.

taps.phrase: to press moss into the mud
